title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This equation predicts the $$self_{rating}$$ based on the value of $$critic_1$$.

title: Effect of Dividing $$critic_1$$ by $$2$$
text: If you divide $$critic_1$$ by $$2$$, the equation becomes $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 \frac{critic_1}{2}$$.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
text: Dividing $$critic_1$$ by $$2$$ effectively changes the slope of the line in the equation, which is represented by $$\theta_1$$.
